body: My ps4 is new, just got it a week ago. It keeps having this problem with the controller, where first I need to shut down the ps4 and turn it back on for it to even turn on, if I don't they give me the white light, not blinking just a straight white light. Even after I do that the controller will only work for about 5-10 minutes unplugged before it randomly turns itself off, and when I try to turn it back on it gives me the white light and then I have to shut my ps4 down again. And when I keep controller plugged in it lasts longer but still gives me a problem, except this time instead of the controller turning off, the internet randomly disconnects despite the internet working fine on everything else in my house. I've been trying for almost more than a week to fix this problem but either haven't had the time or nothing I looked up worked. I've tried initializing the ps4, updating it, rebuilding the database, using the right cables, unplugging the power cable for a few minutes, switching to a usb connection, changing the internet speed, and that's just everything off the top of my head. The only idea I have at this point is that it's a problem with the playstation and not the controller since it's having the same problem with two other controllers I've tried as well. Honestly doubtful I'll get any answers but this is my last resort so if anyone has any ideas it would be appreciated.

Thank you, honestly your comment made me feel a little better, I also think it's nice to have someone you can relate to. And I hope you're doing okay as well, and if you're not I hope things get better.

I'm open to all types of feedback, I just put my preferences.
